notes: Passive dynamic cardioid microphone — moving-coil transducer, no internal electronics requiring power. It must NOT be phantom-powered (48V phantom power is not needed and Shure does not recommend it, though pin wiring makes it generally tolerant; some users pair it with an inline preamp like a Cloudlifter which itself is phantom-powered by the mixer/interface, but that is a separate accessory, not part of the SM7B itself). Single output: 3-pin XLR male, output impedance 150 ohms (rated for connection to mic inputs 19-300 ohms). No grade applies to XLR3 (not in the bandwidth-graded connector list). Desktop/handheld microphone — no rack units. Dimensions: 189.7mm (L) x 63.5mm (max dia), weight 765g. Mounts via integrated captive nut, 5/8"-27 thread (mechanical mount, not an electrical port, so not listed). Category set to "audio" (no more specific "Microphone" fit issue) and type set to "Microphone" per the provided type enum.
